column1: # HumanMusic merge holdout v6 (closeout, final head): 28 rows; PREDECLARED, NOT YET EXECUTED. One contact, no fitting.
# WHY v6: the library source changed AFTER v5's first contact (v5 = 28/28 at 7110cee, preserved as
#   recorded): the closeout listening diff found an accidental change - the pad-tail law cut the
#   final harmony's consonant tail before the piece end in 360/450 BAND performances (no law states
#   it); it was repaired red-first. v6 repeats v5's reviewed 28-row design unchanged except every seed
#   moves to the unused 978xxxxx range, and is declared before any contact with the final source.
# Every generated source and every target plays BAND at a declared drum restraint
#   (band-<restraint> = PerformanceProfile::BAND.with_drum_restraint(<restraint>)): rehearsed
#   admission, arbitrated percussion, the harmonic vocabulary as a source law, earned support
#   functions (incl. this round's laws: the sounding support answers for harmonic identity;
#   relational pitch functions name a destination that sounds and resolves; a declared bass figure
#   keeps the downbeat its own line needs). No historical (POCKET) arm: R17 is judged by its own gate.
# Source law (generated): the consolidated PerformanceReceipt under the source profile must pass
#   (perform_checked): song conformance, score domains, pitch functions present and true in time,
#   no held-identity flip, causal hearings, lawful continuations, occupancy, every verb performed,
#   nobody off stage, the performance domain, every declared anchor established, the vocabulary.
#   A red source still proceeds to extraction and lift, so its evidence is kept.
# Declared grammar: a StablePropulsion composer selects PropulsiveReturn by design, so every
#   StablePropulsion row declares PropulsiveReturn (v4's V09/V14/V20 declaration error is not repeated).
# Identity under overlap: wherever the map pins Motif, Riff or BassFigure, a non-identity event of
#   that instrument's own kind added at an identity onset must leave the extracted map unchanged.
# Cover law: a lift is admitted only as CoverAdmission = PerformanceReceipt + CoverConformance,
#   with every pinned axis receipted, and must not replay its source. A refusal must be in the
#   declared family, at the stage that may make it.
# Stress rows for this round's laws: rootless-support identity (V03 VAPOR95 fusion deflected 33.25,
#   V04 demo 7.25, V19 demo 64); truncated relational function (V05 BLACK_ICE fusion deflected
#   33.25); bass figure room at one-bar forms (V06 RiffDrive 2.5 bass-only, V07 WorldSwitch 4.0).
# Cross-swing Groove with another identity axis: V09 (VAPOR95 swung -> BLACK_ICE straight,
#   groove+motif), V10 (BLACK_ICE -> VAPOR95, groove+bass), V19 (VAPOR95 -> VAPOR95 same-swing
#   control). The canonical groove QUOTIENT must survive the target's swing transport; performed
#   float onsets are NOT required to match across worlds.
# Ode -> SWISS derived harmony (O02) is declared `lawful`: the SWISS vocabulary may refuse it.
# Refusal-bearing rows: V16 and V21 (a fusion source at preset-strict lifted into SWISS simple)
#   and O02 are expected to exercise the vocabulary refusal; V08 may refuse its pinned attacks.
#   O03 (Ode Strict -> BLACK_ICE fusion) is `lawful`, NOT a predicted refusal.
# Boundary: each stress row is ONE seed of a shape whose mechanism fired in ~1-8% of matching
#   fresh cases before this round's laws; a row exercises the shape, it does not guarantee the
#   mechanism triggers. The exploratory searches carry the mechanism evidence.
# Expectation families: lift (a real prediction: the cover must be admitted; used sparingly),
#   nothing (the selection pins no song identity), lawful (a refusal in the declared family,
#   nothing to cover, or an admitted lift).
# Lawful refusal family: ConflictingPins / MissingAxis (an axis the source never established) at
#   extraction; at lift, "pinned harmony ... outside target vocabulary", "no lawful harmony contains
#   the pinned simultaneous attacks", "no lawful pitch function in the target harmony", and the
#   planner's VOCABULARY_REFUSAL, and "a pinned theme has no seated phrase to be stated in the
#   target form" (a documented lawful refusal). UnprojectableTiming and "a pinned stroke has no
#   drum seat" are NOT in the family: either would be a defect.
